test_embedding_with_different_lengths: test vLLM long text embedding with chunked processing for short, medium, long, and very long texts
test_batch_embedding: test batch embedding generation with mixed-length inputs using the vLLM OpenAI-compatible API
test_multiple_long_texts_batch: test batch processing of multiple long texts to verify chunk ID uniqueness and embedding correctness
test_embedding_consistency: test that chunked embedding generation produces consistent results across multiple runs
generate_long_text: generate long text by repeating a base text string a specified number of times
